assessment_basis: Static review of the repository README and linked feature, architecture or roadmap documentation. Source-level deep audit and CI/test rerun were not performed for this adoption.

evidence.claim: Reference runtime, Studio, LSP/DAP and partial native C17 work are tracked as connected workstreams with explicit limits.
The feature matrix separates available reference-runtime behavior from partial native compiler and MMIO contracts.

limitations: Native C17 is not feature-equivalent to the reference runtime and is not a general machine-code backend.
No test or CI workflow was re-run during ladder adoption.
next_gate: Compile and execute a declared .rpr subset through the native path.
Add reference/native parity fixtures and host ABI validation for that subset.
Run reproducible target CI and record the exact supported compiler/platform matrix.
